# Ahmed Al Maghribi Perfumes

> **Corporate Profile**
> * **Founder:** Mr. Kafeel Ahmed Gudekar
> * **Founded:** 2000, UAE
> * **Global Presence:** 190+ Stores across GCC; Exports to 100+ countries
> * **Key Milestones:** Silver Jubilee (2025); Launch of Dulook (2026)
> 
> 

---

## **I. Signature Anniversary Collections**

*A distinguished trilogy composed personally by the founder to mark 25 years of mastery.*

* **K-2000 (The Roots) — AED 375**
* **Notes:** Grapefruit, Jasmine, Aldehydes (Top); White Flowers, Lily, Indian Rose, Saffron (Heart); Oud Hindi, Aged Shamama, Vanilla, Musk (Base).


* **K-2025 (The Alchemy Lab) — AED 375**
* **Notes:** Bergamot, Mandarin, Apple, Juniper, Saffron (Top); Sambac Jasmine, Neroli, Cardamom, Sandalwood, Bakhoor (Heart); Signature Cambodi Oud, Leather Accord, Ambergris, Musk (Base).


* **K-2050 (The Beyond) — AED 375**
* **Notes:** Peach, Pear, Mandarin, Ginger (Top); Freesia, Orange Blossom, Saffron, Leather (Heart); Incense, Ambroxan, Vanilla, Rose, Musk (Base).



---

## **II. 2026 Flagship Release**

* **Dulook (Extrait de Parfum) — AED 275**
* **Description:** "The Decline of the Sun," capturing the transition between tradition and modernity.
* **Notes:** Grapefruit, Bergamot, Pink Pepper, Apple (Top); Cardamom, Saffron, Orris, Rose, Raspberry (Heart); Oud, Vetiver, Cashmere Wood, Ambery Warmth, Vanilla (Base).
